issues.summary: Verify and publish the deployment diagram revision
issues.description:
Check and publish the deployment-only changes to the shared Visual Paradigm project.

Acceptance criteria:

  • Compare the saved model with the shared baseline and confirm that only the deployment diagram changed.

  • Check the exported preview for readable labels, protocol-port details and clear connections.

  • Publish the revision to Teamwork and verify the new shared revision.

  • Commit the native model, preview and verification evidence to the shared repository.

comments.body:
Checked the published copy in VP revision 55. It contains the corrected deployment layout and protocol-port labels, and the other 191 diagrams are unchanged. The deployment diagram is ready to show.

Deployment model and preview

issues.summary: Clarify deployment layout and protocol-port labels
issues.description:
Fix the deployment diagram layout and communication labels from the Assignment 1 feedback.

Acceptance criteria:

  • Place devices, execution environments and artifacts so labels and connections are readable without overlap.

  • Label each communication path with the verified protocol and port used by the deployed app.

  • Preserve existing model identities and leave all other diagrams unchanged.

  • Save the revised native model and a readable deployment preview.

comments.body:
Rearranged the deployment diagram so the connections do not cross. Added HTTPS/TCP 443 labels to the six network paths and HTTP/TCP 8080 to the internal API server. The other 191 diagrams are unchanged. These changes are published in VP revision 55.

Deployment diagram and checks

issues.summary: Review risk ratings and link mitigation tasks
issues.description:
Review all risk cards and link each one to the work needed to manage it.

Acceptance criteria:

  • Every risk has a relevant Linked work item.

  • Probability, impact and status reflect the current findings.

  • Active risks name the next action and the task responsible for it.

  • Keep comments short and save the updated register in the shared repository.

issues.summary: Visual Paradigm compatibility may block shared model updates
issues.description:
The corrected deployment diagram is published in VP revision 55. The shared copy contains the new layout and protocol-port labels.

A version mismatch previously blocked an import, and the command-line commit tool later failed. Desktop Team Commit worked. Future version mismatches could still interrupt imports or sharing, so this risk stays under monitoring.

comments.body: Desktop Team Commit published the deployment diagram in VP revision 55. I checked that the shared copy includes the corrected layout and port labels. The publication issue is cleared; version compatibility still needs checking before future updates.

risk_mitigation: Back up the native project before updating Visual Paradigm. Check that team members use compatible versions. Use Desktop Team Commit and check the shared revision after publishing.
